hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232350 ('No electrical or sewer hookups are available'; 'No RV hookups are available') + RIDB campsite catalog (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20) (all 35 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC, Water/Sewer Hookup 'No'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 12 pull-through sites. The catalog gives lengths for only 8 sites (20-40 ft); the Forest Service's posted maximum is 45 ft. Vehicles must fit on the parking spur.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/monarch-park-campground ('Maximum RV length is 45 feet') + RIDB campsite catalog (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20) (35 standard sites, 12 Pull-Through) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232350 ('Vehicles must fit on parking spur'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Water comes from a hand pump, out of service at last report (bring all water). Nearest dump station at the Poncha Springs Visitor Center.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232350 ('Vault toilets are available'; 'The hand pump is still being repaired so water is currently not available'; 'The nearest RV dump station is at the Poncha Springs Visitor Center'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: June to September per the Forest Service, weather dependent; recreation.gov's 2027 first-come season runs May 28 - September 18.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/monarch-park-campground ('Seasons of Use: June to September') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232350/rates (First-come, First-served Season 2027-05-28 to 2027-09-18), read 2026-10-27

values.note: First-come, first-served only since the 2026 reopening; pay at the self-service fee tube (cash or check). Sites must be occupied the first night paid. No phone service at the campground.

booking.source: RIDB campsite catalog (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20) (all 35 sites reservable false) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232350/rates (2026 and 2027 seasons 'First-come, First-served') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/monarch-park-campground ('Reservations are not available at this time'; 'A self-service fee tube is available'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: $22 a night on recreation.gov's 2026 and 2027 rate tables (a no-water discount is reflected while the pump is out); the Forest Service page posts $24. A third vehicle is $10. Senior/Access pass 50% off.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232350/rates (Walk In STANDARD NONELECTRIC 22, 2026-08-21 to 2026-09-19 and 2027-05-28 to 2027-09-18) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/monarch-park-campground ('$24 fee per site for overnight camping'), read 2026-10-27

note: Salida RD (Pike-San Isabel NF) campground at 10,500 ft below Monarch Pass, along the South Fork of the Arkansas River; reopened August 21, 2026 after a renovation. --Claude
